name: search_pubmed
description: Search PubMed for scientific papers. Returns abstracts, authors, year, and direct PubMed URLs. Can filter by year. Use this inside analysis scripts to find relevant literature.

parameters.query: string — search terms (e.g. 'FOXO3 aging longevity', 'mTOR rapamycin lifespan')
parameters.min_year: int — filter to papers from this year onward (e.g. 2020)

returns: dict with papers list: pmid, title, authors, year, abstract, pubmed URL
